notes.title: Added achievements
notes.content:
[h1]Added achievements[/h1]

Four new achievements, something that was on my list to add and that a user asked about recently in the Community Hub.

Here are the 4 achievements:
-When collecting your first secret cube
-When collecting all the secret cubes
-When finishing the game
-When finishing the game in under 10 minutes

notes.title: Update - Added Ending Timer!
notes.content:
[h1]Ending Timer[/h1]

Changes made:
[list]
[*] Added a timer so you can see how long it took to complete the game
[/list]

This is since a few people requested this feature to see how long it took them to complete the game!
